tools.name: capability_search
tools.description: Search across the supported Zambo tool catalog for a use case. Returns relevant tools with relevance scores, descriptions, taglines, and callable API endpoints. Referral searches find the invite-link tool and its 2,000-call reward for an activated paid Day Pass. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Read private saved facts by caller handle or explicit memory code, optionally matching a query. Uses the shared daily work-call allowance. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: Save a private fact for this work connection. Returns a private memory code for cross-session pickup; keep it secret. Uses the shared daily work-call allowance and respects Memory capture settings. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: _session_id, fact.

tools.name: scam_check
tools.description: Check plain text or a wallet, contract, domain, or URL for scam and phishing indicators. URLs and wallet addresses in supplied text are checked with SCAMRA threat intelligence; EVM wallets may also receive an optional Criptic cross-reference. Returns clean, caution, scam, or unknown with confidence,

tools.name: day_pass_redeem
tools.description: Unlock this AI with your private Day Pass link. No headers needed. The link expires with the original pass. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: spend_limit_set
tools.description: Set this work connection's daily and optional monthly dollar cap before further Day Pass payments. Free, no quota. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: _session_id, daily_usd.

tools.name: spend_limit_status
tools.description: Read this work connection's spending cap, paid charges and remaining budget. Free, no quota. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: _session_id.

tools.name: handover_accept
tools.description: Accepts and picks up a handover by ID or resume code, returns its full saved state and private continuation thread, and records a receipt. Agent pickup is not client approval; the client decision remains pending. Do not generate client tokens. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: handover
tools.description: Call this when the user says 'wrap up this session', 'continue in another AI', or 'hand this over to <client>'. For AI switching, create a resumable handoff with the same session. For client delivery, return one proof link with verifiable receipts. Pass continue_from to chain off a job you picked up

tools.name: handover_status
tools.description: Checks a handover by ID or resume code, including pickup status and the separate client decision/release hint. Agent pickup alone does not authorize payment release. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: handover_list
tools.description: List your Zambo Handovers using Zambo Pass and the same _session_id. Returns real statuses and client-ready links. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: _session_id.

tools.name: zambo_home
tools.description: Your private Zambo starting point: six ready-to-say goals, today's receipts and actual usage. Ask what Zambo can do for your business, site, code or money. Free. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: activity_today
tools.description: Read the private, receipt-backed work ledger for this job and return its Today link. Always free and does not use the daily call allowance. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: workflow_close
tools.description: Create or return a fixed snapshot with a verifiable receipt of every persisted receipt from this job, including rejected and errored calls. Repeating the call with unchanged receipt data returns the same snapshot workflow_id; later calls after new receipts create a separate snapshot while session_wo

tools.name: workflow_seal
tools.description: Seals a closed workflow for durable export. Requires the matching job session and an active pass. Never spends, captures, or starts a payment. The export remains a Zambo claim, not issuer authentication. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: workflow_id, _session_id.

tools.name: zambo_universal
tools.description: Universal Zambo entry point for routing natural-language requests across supported Zambo tools through one MCP connection. Covers strategy, code audits, lead generation, wallet intelligence, provenance certificates, parallel work coordination, and live market data. Returns a route, execution state,

tools.name: new_session
tools.description: Starts fresh session context and returns a new session_id. Reuse that ID on subsequent calls for continuity; changing or omitting it starts clean context. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: .

tools.name: continuity_get_recent
tools.description: Reads receipt-backed work for a job or named thread. Pass resume_code to retrieve the complete saved handover, notes, handover ID and JSON URL; otherwise use the existing private job ID. Use since and the returned cursor to continue paginated history. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: continuity_list_threads
tools.description: Lists named threads owned by the supplied job ID. Thread IDs can be used as _session_id by another AI client. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: continuity_open_thread
tools.description: Opens a named thread or thread ID and returns only events with stored Zambo receipts, including links to open and check each receipt. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: continuity_start_thread
tools.description: Creates or reuses a named thread under an existing job ID. Pass the returned thread_id as _session_id to append work from another AI client. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: name.

tools.name: continuity_set_prefs
tools.description: Changes whether future successful calls are captured in the private timeline. It does not remove or hide public receipts already created. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: journal_log
tools.description: Free anonymous or authenticated append-only log for an action performed outside Zambo. The entry is recorded as an agent-reported claim; Zambo does not claim it ran or observed the action. Limited to 20 calls per IP per day on the free tier. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: job

tools.name: live_price
tools.description: Real-time cryptocurrency price lookup for supported coins. Uses CoinGecko first, Coinbase as a secondary no-key provider, then the most recent cached verified value with its age if both live providers are unavailable. Returns live USD price, 24-hour percentage change, and market capitalization when

tools.name: pdf_extract
tools.description: Fetch and extract text content from any public URL - PDF documents, web pages, articles, docs. Returns the extracted text, word count, and a summary. Works on research papers, contracts, articles, reports. Use when user says 'read this PDF', 'extract from this URL', 'summarize this document', 'what

tools.name: leadsignal
tools.description: AI lead generation for contractors and local service businesses. Accepts a trade type and city. Returns qualified local leads with available contact information. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: trade, city.

tools.name: provibe_audit
tools.description: AI code audit for a public GitHub repository. Returns a Provibe score from 0 to 100, security vulnerabilities, a dead-code map, and an execution plan for addressing the findings. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: repo_url.

tools.name: ghost_audit_site
tools.description: website audit for a website. Returns SEO gaps, AI discoverability issues, conversion leaks, brand-presence gaps, competitor intelligence, a score from 0 to 100, stage findings, an audit ID, a live stream URL, and a report URL. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: url.

tools.name: ghost_audit_status
tools.description: Status report for a Ghost Audit identified by audit_id. Returns whether the audit is running or complete, along with elapsed-time information and report availability. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: audit_id.

tools.name: ghost_audit_report
tools.description: Full markdown report for a completed Ghost Audit. Returns the website score, severity-ranked findings, stage analysis, and recommended fixes. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: audit_id.

tools.name: credithunt
tools.description: Live verified index of AI and cloud startup credit programs. Accepts optional stack, stage, and minimum value filters. Returns count, updated_at, opportunities, and api. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

tools.name: prompt_shield
tools.description: Detection and analysis of prompt injection, jailbreak, and policy-bypass attempts. Returns an injection risk score, a safe/review/block recommendation, attack indicators, and a safe rewritten version when available. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline. Required arguments: prompt.

tools.name: day_pass_checkout_link
tools.description: Get a checkout link for the $0.99, 24-hour Day Pass by card or PayPal, including in a fresh session. Creating the link never charges anyone; payment requires completing checkout. Optional workflow_id targets a closed run; sponsor:true explicitly sponsors another team's run without transferring brand

tools.name: day_pass_activate
tools.description: Agent-native access activation endpoint. Accepts an optional payment envelope or existing access key and returns a payment challenge or verified activation result. Activation results include receipt URL, run ID, access key, expiration, usage guidance, and a spend receipt. Activation occurs only afte

tools.name: day_pass_status
tools.description: Check your current pass, also available as pass_status. All arguments are optional: current session, token_or_link, thread_id, or _zambo_key. Returns a plain status line, active, tier, expires_at, seconds_left and a private unlock link without spending quota. Product/provider limits may still apply.

tools.name: pass_status
tools.description: Exact alias of day_pass_status. Free and uncapped. Returns the same plain status line and top-level pass fields; no arguments required. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.
